name: @solverdict/sak-adapter
description: Run any Solana Agent Kit agent through the SolVerdict scenarios on your own machine.
author: Alrimar Sobrinho

scripts.test: tsx test/capture.test.ts && tsx test/submit.test.ts && tsx test/roster.test.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && node ../../scripts/check-package-state-leak.mjs

//pins: ai + @ai-sdk/anthropic are EXACT-pinned to the versions the SolVerdict benchmark uses (root package.json) — the adapter must drive SAK identically to how the benchmark drives it, since that is what SolVerdict measures. solana-agent-kit and @solana/web3.js are peers so the adapter operates on the SAME instances/classes as the developer's agent.
